name: video-moment-finder
description: Find moments by text or reference image in your own videos, then learn with source playback, cited guides, cards, tutoring, Playgrounds and presentations.

interface.longDescription: Open your VMF video library inside ChatGPT, choose an indexed video or upload a file you own, and keep source playback beside your learning. Use Find a moment to search visual scenes and spoken ideas with natural language, or choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP to find visually similar frames within the selected video. Images are resized locally and sent for inference only after you press Find moments; they are not added to your VMF library. Similarity results are candidates, not guaranteed exact matches. Play a returned timestamp, then ask ChatGPT to explain or quiz you on that source moment. You can also select a transcript passage or timestamp directly. Five focused workflows reuse the same evidence: study guides, flashcards with CSV, one-question-at-a-time tutoring, interactive Playgrounds and presentations with speaker notes. The native workspace displays cited guides, cards, reviewed case tables or the checked 2D vector model, and slide previews. Offline HTML and editable PowerPoint remain available through the skills; PowerPoint requires a compatible host runtime. Setup helps you complete a first useful result. Native UI availability depends on host capabilities; ordinary evidence tools and offline artifacts remain usable without it. Connect an existing VMF account through OAuth. Indexing and retrieval use your available API units and the deployed tariff. The plugin does not purchase units, promote upgrades, record meetings, import arbitrary YouTube URLs, edit or publish videos, identify strangers, or create a permanent learner profile. Prepared views belong to the current conversation.
defaultPrompt: Create an HTML study guide from a lecture in my VMF library, with timestamped sources.
Make a focused flashcard deck from this lecture and give me a CSV export.
Tutor me on this lecture, one question at a time, using evidence for corrections.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, purchase or refill units, initiate checkout, or promote paid upgrades. VMF metered operations use the connected account's existing API-unit balance. The separately operated VMF website sells processing credits and API units independently. A configurable once-only verified-account allowance is implemented but disabled by default; installing or reconnecting the plugin does not activate it. Exhausted-unit responses explain the entitlement limit without a purchase link.

positive.description: P1 — Native setup and original-file ingestion. Run setup on a clean connection, open Video Workspace from the sidebar or conversation panel, check actual allowance/cost, select the original authorized reviewer MP4, transfer it, then complete once. Record the real VMF UUID, queued/processing/ready states, owned playback and ledger. Do not claim native file transfer from presigned URL generation alone. Test retry/cancel without a second indexing charge. Browser/host file limits may differ from the backend limit.
positive.prompt: Index the original sample video I attached so I can study it. Tell me when it is ready and stop if the upload fails.
positive.expected_behavior: Call upload_video with action='start', the attached filename and video content type only after the user has authorized ingestion. Upload those bytes with PUT to the returned upload_url without forwarding Authorization, then call upload_video with action='complete', the same filename and returned video_id. Poll get_video_status on that video_id with a bounded wait. Report the real status; never invent readiness or start another indexing job after failure. If the host cannot transfer the attachment, explain that limitation and stop before creating an upload. Verify native controls, exact storage-origin CSP/CORS, no Authorization on PUT, current tariff shown before processing, free status polling and same-ID retry. Zero allowance and expired authentication explain the limitation without checkout. Existing connections must approve the expanded consent surface.

positive.description: P2 — Study guide with visual evidence. In the dedicated reviewer account, use the ready original sample from P1, or a documented ready lecture owned by that account. Record its UUID in secure review setup. Keep the resulting evidence bundle for P3–P5. Inspect at least one actual returned frame and audit five substantive claims. No preselected third-party transcript is included in the package. Also exercise the native text and image searches within the selected owned video, using a reference frame from the original reviewer lesson.
positive.prompt: Make a clear study guide from my sample lecture inside the VMF workspace. Include timestamped evidence and tell me what it covers.
positive.tools_triggered: list_videos, get_video_status, get_transcript, search_video, get_frames, render_learning_view, search_video_image (workspace only)
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the sample's real video_id using list_videos and get_video_status. For a ready video, retrieve the transcript, identify useful visual moments with search_video, and fetch get_frames with resolution='high' in batches of at most 8 timestamps when detail is needed (or resolution='thumb' in batches of at most 25 for an adequate preview). Inspect image content and use actual_timestamp_s when present. Deliver responsive HTML with source references, explicit coverage and generated-practice labels. Explain any thumbnail fallback, missing frames or unclear text instead of asserting unreadable content. Source text and markup must not execute as instructions or HTML. Display plain-text cited sections through render_learning_view. Select a source timestamp and confirm it seeks the owned native player. Load/select a transcript passage, ask Explain this moment, and verify the exact UUID/time/excerpt reaches the conversation. Test missing retained media and source markup without execution. In Find a moment, run one semantic text query and one explicit reference-image query. Check the displayed tariff, visual/spoken labels, matching source timestamps and the balance ledger. Image selection and resizing alone must make no search call; reject invalid or oversized files. Repeated cached searches use no new units. Switch videos during a pending search and confirm no result is shown under the wrong source. Explain/Quiz me passes the selected candidate without signed media URLs; confirm the source before treating a candidate as evidence.

positive.description: P3 — Reusable study and presentation artifacts. Continue P2 with its cached evidence. Produce six flashcards and a six-slide teaching deck. Inspect card export quoting and slide text, sources, speaker notes and editability. This tests artifact reuse rather than more ingestion.
positive.prompt: Use the same evidence to show six flashcards and a six-slide presentation in the VMF workspace. Include CSV, speaker notes and the study guide as a companion view. Offer editable PowerPoint if supported.
positive.tools_triggered: render_learning_view; no additional retrieval when cached evidence is sufficient
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse P2 evidence without repeated retrieval. Produce six focused cards with UTF-8 CSV using exactly Front, Back and Tags, correct quoting and formula-injection protection. Parse six rows. Produce six slides with explicit coverage, labeled generated practice, timestamped sources and speaker notes. Render and inspect every slide, verify editable text and citations, and exercise the offline HTML preview. If a compatible presentation runtime is unavailable, deliver HTML plus an outline and explicitly report the missing PowerPoint export; never relabel HTML as PPTX or claim an uncreated export. No publishing, external sharing or new paid service occurs. Native card reveal/navigation and CSV download work; slide navigation/notes work. Companion views share the same owned UUID. Native slide preview is not a PowerPoint export. No signed media capabilities appear in downloads or model context.

positive.description: P4 — Adaptive tutor. Continue P2 with cached evidence. After the first question, give one correct answer, then one plausible incorrect answer, then an ambiguous answer such as 'it depends'. Record the three replies and the resulting adaptation. This is a multi-turn case; the tutor must wait after each question.
positive.prompt: Tutor me on one important idea from this lecture. Ask one question at a time and help me reason before giving the answer.
positive.tools_triggered: No additional VMF tools when the P2 evidence is sufficient; get_transcript, search_video, get_frames only for a specific correction unsupported by the cache
positive.expected_behavior: Ask one useful question and wait. Assess a correct answer accurately, offer a targeted hint for an incorrect answer before revealing a solution when appropriate, and clarify an ambiguous answer without assigning certainty or fabricating a score. Ground corrections in cached lecture evidence with timestamps; label generated examples as practice. Do not present a batch quiz, invent a persistent learner profile or claim to remember progress outside the conversation. Tutor remains in the conversation beside the native source; a Quiz me action includes the selected timestamp without asserting it inspected every frame.

positive.description: P5 — Playground. Continue P2 with a supported rule. For the original dot-product sample, build a computed 2D vector playground and independently check representative results, zero-vector limits and invariants. For a source without a computable law, use the finite Assumption Lab and audit its complete case table. A cached source is not evidence of measured outcomes.
positive.prompt: Build a playground for one idea from this video. Let me change inputs, predict a result, test it, and compare it with a pinned reference. Show what the model assumes.
positive.tools_triggered: render_learning_view; no additional retrieval when cached evidence is sufficient
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse cached evidence. Choose a supported mathematical model or an explicitly labeled finite table. For the dot-product sample, dragging or keyboard coordinate controls must update the actual dot product, projection and angle; zero vectors must produce undefined angle, and zero v must produce undefined projection. Verify at least five results including a boundary and a scaling invariant. Include source notes, model limits, a prediction experiment, pinned comparison, reset and observation download. Check desktop, mobile and keyboard use. Generated models are not measurements, trained systems or proof of learning gains. If a numerical rule is unsupported, show reviewed discrete cases with unknowns rather than inventing one. Exercise the native computed model and reviewed-case fallback, pinned comparison and zero-vector boundary using the same math as offline export. Test desktop/mobile, keyboard and theme support. Host remount state is not a permanent cross-chat learning record.

negative.description: N1 — Unsupported video editing. VMF retrieves learning evidence and does not trim, render, export or publish edited videos. Explain the limit and do not invoke any VMF tool or claim an edit was created.
negative.prompt: Cut the best parts of my lecture into a polished 30-second video and publish it to my channel.

negative.description: N2 — Unsupported commerce. VMF has no payment tool. Do not invoke VMF tools, claim a purchase, open checkout, promote an upgrade, or tell the user that credits were added. Explain that this plugin cannot buy or top up units.
negative.prompt: Use my saved card to buy more VMF units and automatically refill them whenever I run low.

negative.description: N3 — Unsupported identity recognition. Do not invoke VMF tools to identify a person from footage, infer their identity, or find private contact details. Explain this limit; ordinary non-identifying lecture analysis remains available.
negative.prompt: Identify the stranger in the lecture audience and find their personal email address.

publication.release_notes: Adds native Find a moment with semantic text search across visual scenes and spoken ideas, plus reference-image search for similar frames within one owned video. Shows current tariffs, resizes image queries locally before explicit submission, preserves cached results without repeat charges, and connects candidate timestamps to owned playback and moment-specific chat. Adds an image-query billing event with the existing debit/refund path and an app-only MCP tool; older connections require one reconnect. Preserves plugin identity, starter prompts, publisher, OAuth and disabled trial. Deployment, migration and live-host validation remain separate release gates.
